data.gender_notes: Hitu is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hitu is recorded with the meaning “Sun's Ray”. Hitu is a Sanskrit name meaning “Sun's Ray”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_marathi.name: Hitu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'hritu' meaning 'sun's ray' or 'light'. In Hindu mythology, Hitu is believed to symbolize brightness and enlightenment.
